//overrides: Force Next's bundled sharp/postcss to patched versions. Next ships older copies (sharp <0.35.0 / postcss <8.5.10) that npm audit can only 'fix' by downgrading Next to 9.3.3; these are build-time only (static export, images unoptimized) so pinning the patched versions is safe. postcss is scoped under 'next' (nested override) because a root postcss override collides with the direct devDependency (EOVERRIDE), and $postcss=^8 would not bump Next's pinned 8.4.31. brace-expansion is pinned to 5.0.8 (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, DoS/OOM, affects <=5.0.7): it is a transitive dep of ESLint's minimatch (devDependency, lint-time only) whose 1.x line has no patched release, so a global pin to the fixed 5.0.8 is the only fix short of a breaking eslint@10 upgrade; the expand() API is unchanged across majors.
